Cough

A cough will usually clear up on its own within a few weeks.

Things you can try

  • Rest and drink plenty of fluids.

Urgent advice: Ask for help

Contact NHS 111 if you are very unwell.

Immediate action required

Call 999 if you cannot breathe.
